Hi Daniel,

Looks like we just missed each other for our scheduled intro — no worries. I wanted to follow up quickly with an easy way to rebook. Two quick options if either works:

• Thu Jul 6, 10:00–10:30 AM PT
• Fri Jul 7, 2:00–2:30 PM PT

If neither fits, here’s a link to my calendar to pick a time that works for you: https://cal.link/vanessa/redwood

If helpful, I can loop in our solutions engineer to cover security/compliance questions. Let me know which time you prefer or just grab any open slot from the link.

Look forward to connecting — thanks for your time.
